a range of macroinveretbrate indices can be used for the assessment of AMD in low alkalinity rivers, but that taxon richness may be a more reliable metric.

the Brillouin index, BMWP score and taxon richness are the most appropriate metrics for assessing the impact of AMD in the study river, with the Brillouins index and taxon richness the most appropriate for use with a limited number of samples.
